purpose: A proposal-level transparency contract for AI entering public-service pilots. It is inspired by public AI-register mechanisms but redesigned for local institutional review; it is not presented as an enacted Beijing registry standard.

required_fields.question: 这个AI被允许帮助解决什么具体问题？
草案、测试、降级、人工接管、停止还是退出？
哪个机构/岗位对继续运行和错误处理负责？
用了什么数据，为什么需要，是否可以少采？
当前模型/规则何时发生过实质变化？
哪些决定、识别、推断或数据用途被明确禁止？
不使用AI的人怎样完成同一项必要公共任务？
在哪里、由谁、以什么方式转人工或停机？
错误、歧视、隐私或服务问题向谁提出并怎样闭环？
最近一次为什么停、为什么改、是否留下公共回执？

sample_design_record.purpose: 在限定低速测试区验证短距配送是否能减少重复搬运，同时不增加行人和无障碍使用者负担。
sample_design_record.responsible_body: UNKNOWN — must be verified before pilot launch
sample_design_record.data_categories: Conceptual minimum: robot localization, obstacle perception and operational logs; exact sensors/data retention remain UNKNOWN until operator and legal review.
prohibited_capabilities: no expansion outside approved controlled boundary
no continued operation when safe takeover is unavailable
sample_design_record.non_ai_route: human delivery + full ordinary pedestrian route
sample_design_record.human_review: named remote/on-site takeover role required before G1
sample_design_record.complaint_entry: must be a real staffed/public channel before G1; currently UNKNOWN

publication_rule: The public-facing card must use plain language and an accessible non-digital equivalent at civic service locations. Sensitive/security information is not made public merely for the sake of transparency; disclosure scope requires professional and legal review.
no_self_certification: AI may draft or summarize a card but may not declare itself safe, compliant, approved or ready. A real accountable person/institution must sign the launch/continue/stop judgment.
